_meta.brief: Static fallback voice catalog for Agentforce agent persona voice recommendations. Sourced from a periodic scrape of the Agentforce voice menu. When a designer is connected to a live Salesforce org, the skill should prefer fetching the org’s actual voice catalog at runtime; this static set is the fallback and the default for designers without org access. Roadmap: live org-fetch integration. Re-sync from upstream when Salesforce ships new default voices.

voices.name: Pocholo

voices.name: Avelina
voices.description: The ultimate Filipino mother voice. Her voice is warm and familiar like a bowl of arroz caldo on a rainy day or the gentle hand that wipes your tears after a long day. She speaks with grace patience and strength reflecting the true essence of every ilaw ng tahanan. Her tone is calm but commanding sweet yet sincere - perfect for evoking emotion love and a deep sense of home.

Whether for WhatsApp Facebook Messenger Instagram or YouTube his friendly and relatable voice ensures a warm welcoming experience for Tamil-speaking users.

voices.description: Conversational Tamil Voice - Meena is a pen name of a Tamil professional who has spent years in the finance industry. You will observe the calmness and great explanation pace in her voice. A perfect use case for corporate work and for conversational work.

voices.description: Voice with a warm and deep quality that gives listeners a sincere and heartfelt impression while also featuring a cheerful timbre. This balanced vocal tone neither too thin nor too thick offers a fluent and comfortable expression at a moderate pace. By highlighting its expressive power it is perfectly suited for professional presentations radio broadcastin podcast recordings and video voice-overs.
